result.markdown:
For most small businesses, I'd recommend **SignWell or Signable** rather than immediately paying for DocuSign. They're simpler, more affordable options that cover the essentials without the complexity of enterprise software.

If you're running a small business in the UK, I'd shortlist five options.

## Best e-signature software compared

![SignWell Review (2026) — Pros, Cons & Rating](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/Jr7ERfTZr0cqqbqtQojc1WgFegKKLiPrJurgeTes_GrO9qxMF5YkVG9gVLeB9qvt7YBC6Q6pkJBI9N_c51xLlztOk6hKzac7E4lFA8rd9eBpetTe_xy1klt7wGh6uRBKJslwwXSnJXsHHrXPP9HSa1AdMDl53XAX_hATAxwkkaXeQ7t2kL5k6NsdkQn3lUlj?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. SignWell**

(Best value)

- Simple, easy-to-use interface.
- Free plan for occasional signing.
- Paid plans offer unlimited documents.
- Good for freelancers and small teams.
  
  Around \$10/month on annual billing.
  
  [Visit SignWell](https://www.signwell.com/)

---

![Signable - Sales Enablement and E-Signature App for HubSpot | Signable](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/gGvZ428-QbTIsXWx5S3s4zb6kZDelI9e6ZN1kcrVXolj1eCD-CGWYpJUWQVhaaNegb8o5414_h9QprmHzoP6h5tK6DtY4aVvKfnST-Ll6yIMrl8U2ytx_iGlhlJQGLqoqEbDe6PtiDf5VDUiYl3n5stFymYFaK57eWdPcCBx7o-QM2JljTdOAGcEYS_3vHeI?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Signable**

(Best UK option)

- UK-based e-signature provider.
- Unlimited users on its account-based plans.
- Templates, signing reminders and audit trails.
- Pay-as-you-go option for occasional use.
  
  Around £31/month for 50 envelopes.
  
  [Visit Signable](https://www.signable.co.uk/)

---

![Contact Us - Dropbox Sign (Formerly HelloSign)](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/2VacXMMTTAgLv7_tt9CJxRpEx64Pjdo05gOaYRqtaqOv6KLxCsUP9-2-W7fx1bnMTt_RL4ZXXh__9W1oXFphP9NExRIi8BcpBDReMEtSDtlVDQ7gDFbeNxPpubzRi7-28SBjZTZCAw-IRi-qLBsueOgBlB_x3ZAOb2OMkNF-TBUC4p1hEHxhdxeKDroXElUm?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Dropbox Sign**

- Very straightforward to use.
- Good document tracking and templates.
- Integrates with Dropbox and other business tools.
- Particularly good for small teams.
  
  Paid plans from approximately \$15/month.
  
  [Visit Dropbox Sign](https://sign.dropbox.com/)

---

![ドキュサイン / Docusign について](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/xyLq-c8NsrpmXngTDQOlq_nQ-hdoipi8LNAM0PriPm9OXbxzSMFpxHq4mX20RE5oKykXn_ebymihRHVC-xJF-ftlT3muOwPqVZr1LnypOPP6tZDIkDq6IjuWnsebSgjW-6slAQlpUZa-Wz9woFg0UDt6Xeug0D4ulHXJQLs86h2xGptBRDNSUfxqteGaxXDR?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. DocuSign**

- Most widely recognised brand.
- Extensive integrations.
- Excellent templates, tracking and automation.
- Good if you deal with lots of external clients.
  
  UK plans approximately £8–£33/month, depending on plan.
  
  [Visit DocuSign](https://www.docusign.com/en-gb)

---

![PandaDoc buys Denario for consolidated document and payment workflow offering](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/nMZU-ikvjF7B27p2YRYbwMFVYldny8ofYsWDYYkqTXdGfrk-N9sresjiQS7_N5GL_z3bC2xtBlASA1wbjcPGc7QwN2zoEnDhBBAByuwL6PooRYdhb5Xb7bjGtsls49X_kKuOQ8O8ieH---UeiE5fGOQC1qFIRtUd6uc0-JR89a70cw5k0Vpz1IUhRMFOX01b?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. PandaDoc**

- Creates proposals, quotes and contracts.
- Electronic signatures built in.
- Useful for sales teams.
- More features than you need if you just want signatures.
  
  Starter plans around \$19/user/month.
  
  [Visit PandaDoc](https://www.pandadoc.com/)

Prices are approximate November 2026 figures and can vary with billing frequency, VAT and plan limits. [www.sortlist.co.uk](https://www.sortlist.co.uk/blog/software/e-signature-software/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[dupple.com](https://dupple.com/learn/best-e-signature-software?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.helprange.com](https://www.helprange.com/e-signature-comparison?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## What I'd look for before choosing

For a small business, these features matter most\:

- **Legally valid signatures\:** Appropriate for UK contracts and agreements.
- **Audit trail\:** Records who signed, when and relevant signing evidence.
- **Templates\:** Save frequently used contracts so you don't recreate them.
- **Automatic reminders\:** Chase customers who haven't signed.
- **Multiple signatories\:** Allow two or more people to sign the same document.
- **Easy for customers\:** Ideally, customers can sign without creating an account.

## My recommendation

I'd narrow it down to\:

- **Signable** if you're UK-based, have several employees and want straightforward pricing.
- **SignWell** if you're a sole trader or small business looking for affordable, simple signing.
- **DocuSign** if you want a recognised professional platform with room to grow.

## One question so I can recommend the right one

What type of business are you running, and what will you mainly use e-signatures for?

For example, customer contracts, employment agreements, quotes, service agreements, property documents or general business paperwork.

I can then narrow it down to the best two options based on your actual requirements and avoid recommending something unnecessarily expensive.

search_results.description: This 2026 guide evaluates leading e-signature platforms for functionality, security, integrations, usability, device compatibility, and legal compliance. Adobe Acrobat Sign is named the best overall option, offering extensive customization, authentication, SAP SuccessFactors integration, mobile and web access, and plans starting at $16.99 monthly with a seven-day trial. DocuSign is recommended for business value, particularly high-volume signing, with templates, tracking, reporting, strong security, broad integrations, and plans from $10 monthly. Dropbox Sign is the budget choice, emphasizing ease of use, cloud-storage compatibility, branding, templates, and AES-256/TLS encryption from $9.99 monthly. eSignatures.io suits freelancers needing pay-as-you-go bulk contracts, charging per contract with discounted credits. SignNow is best for multiple signers, offering collaboration, reusable templates, drag-and-drop fields, and real-time tracking. PandaDoc is recommended for creating sophisticated documents, combining e-signatures with publishing tools, templates, content libraries, CRM integrations, and payment tracking. The guide advises selecting software based on workflow, compliance, security, features, integrations, and budget.
